data.name: Mrinmoy
data.gender_notes: Mrinmoy is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mrinmoy is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words 'mrin' meaning 'jewel' and 'moy' meaning 'mind'. This name signifies that the one bearing it is a treasure of wisdom and knowledge. It is a name given to those who are considered the bearers of profound knowledge, scholars, and thinkers. The name Mrinmoy carries the meaning “Jewel of the mind” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mrinmoy usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel of the mind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of wisdom and knowledge
data.etymology: Mrinmoy belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jewel of the mind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mrinmoy total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
